files.actualChain: W32Dispatch/W32TryCall invoke F borrow scope around original thunk; dispatch filter temporarily selects entry frame for original W32Exception and restores it before unwind. WOWSysErrorBox has native-call handoff; WOWStartupFailed calls service-authorized exit.
files.disposition: S13: preserve original exception policy in C; assess entry/exception/exit binding together at existing F dispatch boundary. Do not move C TD/layout-dependent adapter into B. Registry C0017 already cleared.

files.actualChain: Read supported fax driver list; create/set shadow fax configuration. HKEY values stay in native locals, unlike WS32 guest registry thunks. Existing B wow_registry.h provides read-only projection but not complete create/set contract.
files.disposition: S13: split local raw-key access from guest-token conversion through the same parent registry authority. Guest token wrapping is not proven necessary for this file; direct modern Registry substitution would select a different store. No new adapter or mirror change implemented.

files.actualChain: Hook callbacks capture stack before conversion; finalizers restore recursion/message/Parm16 state, release acquired16/32 keys, restore stack and fThunkDDEmsg. Journal and mouse callbacks also use stack scope.
files.disposition: S13: group with wmdisp32/wcntl32 callback allocation/unwind; keep original hook conversion and normal copyback. Do not remove normal release while leaving outer unwind able to double-release, or move C-layout-aware release wholesale to B.

files.actualChain: WS32RegOpenKey/CreateKey store returned HKEY into guest DWORD; close/query/delete retrieve guest-supplied value. WOWRegDeleteKey recursively enumerates/deletes using same handle domain. F provider translates tokens to parent raw keys under lock; DLL explicit-unload invokes shutdown.
files.disposition: S13: retain C conversion/recursive-delete policy; place token representation and lifecycle at explicit product integration boundary without parallel registry store. Token mapping and parent storage must not be conflated; no permanent exception approved.

limits: Actual source/generator ownership proof; no new runtime evidence, no assertion that every existing adapter is minimal or permanently required. S13 must establish equivalence before lifecycle moves.
